title: Unemployment Benefit Claims Certification Calendar
content:
Benefit weeks on an Unemployment Benefit Claims record end on Saturday. The calendar figures for certifying a week, counted from that Saturday week ending date, are these:

| Program | Certification opens (calendar days after the week ending date) | Timely through (calendar days after the week ending date) | Late certification with documented good cause accepted through (calendar days after the week ending date) | Consecutive uncertified weeks after which an active claim becomes inactive |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Regular State Unemployment Insurance | 1 | 14 | 90 | 2 |
| Unemployment Compensation for Federal Employees (UCFE) | 1 | 14 | 90 | 2 |
| Unemployment Compensation for Ex-Servicemembers (UCX) | 1 | 14 | 90 | 2 |
| Combined Wage Claim (CWC) | 1 | 14 | 90 | 2 |
| Extended Benefits (EB) | 1 | 14 | 90 | 2 |
| Trade Readjustment Allowances (TRA) | 1 | 14 | 90 | 2 |
| Disaster Unemployment Assistance (DUA) | 1 | 21 | 90 | 2 |

## Reading the calendar

**When does certification for a week open?** One calendar day after the Saturday week ending date, which is the following Sunday.

**Until when is a Regular State Unemployment Insurance certification timely?** Through the 14th calendar day after the week ending date; for a Disaster Unemployment Assistance (DUA) claim the figure is 21.

**What does the 90-day figure set?** The last calendar day after the week ending date through which a late certification may still be accepted with documented good cause.

### Hypothetical dates

For a hypothetical week ending Saturday 6 June, certification opens Sunday 7 June; under the 14-day figure the last timely day is Saturday 20 June, and under the 21-day figure it is Saturday 27 June.
